name: cable triceps pushdown (v bar) v. 2
description: A triceps pushdown using a V bar on a high cable, a classic for the back of the arms.
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the V bar with elbows at your sides.
Keep your torso upright and slightly forward.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly, elbows still.
